content: Depit eri mengimengloalki, “Ehu rahn pwukat Sohl pahn kemeiehla. Ihte me keieu mwahu I en tangalahng Pilisdia. Eri, Sohl pahn sohla rapahkin ie nan Israel, I ahpw sohte pahn diar apwal.”
Depit oh nah ohl wenepwikio eri mwadangete mweselahng rehn Akis nein Maok, nanmwarkien Kad.
Depit oh nah ohl ako eri kousoanla nan Kad iangahki arail peneinei kan. Depit oh eh pwoud riemeno iang ih, Ahinoam sang Sesreel, oh Apikail, en Napal me melahro eh pwoud, sang Karmel.
Ni Sohl eh karongehda me Depit sopolahngehr nan Kad, e ahpw sohla rapahki.
Depit eri ndahng Akis, “Ma komwi kompoakepahi, eri komw mweidohng ie ehu kisin kahnimw en pwe I en kousoan loale. Maing, sohte anahnepen I en iang komwi kousoan nan poahsoan kaunen kahnimwet.”
Akis eri ketikihong kisin kahnimw Siklak, ih kahrepe wet me nanmwarkien Suda sapwellimanikihla kisin kahnimw Siklak.
Depit koukousoanki nan Pilisdia erein sounpwong eisek weneu.
Erein ahnsowo Depit oh nah ohl ako kin mahweniong tohn Kesur, Kirsi, oh Amalek, me koukousoan nan sahpwo ahnsou reirei. E kin mahweniong sahpwo lao lellahng Sur, oh pil leldilahng nan Isip,
kemekemehla ohl oh lih koaros oh kin wahsang neirail sihpw, kou, ahs, kamel, oh pil arail likou kan. E ahpw pahn kin pwurodo rehn Akis,
me kin kalelapak reh, “Ia wasa ke mahwen ie met?” Depit eri kin ndahng me e kohla palieir en Suda de nan sapwen kadaudok en Serameel de nan sahpw wasa me mehn Ken kan kin kousoan ie.
Depit eri kin kemehla koaros, ohl oh lih, pwe emen irail de pwurala nan Kad oh ndahda dahme ih oh nah ohl ako wiadahr. Ih met me Depit kin wiewia nindokon eh koukousoan nan Pilisdia.
Ahpw Akis kin likih Depit oh kin mengimengloalki, “E pahn uhpah ie erein eh mour pwehki kiseh mehn Israel kan ar kailongki.”
